Commentary.Commentary: A target of 335 has been set in front of India. The hosts possess a deep batting line-up but the Australian bowlers have persisted  consistently with good lines, not allowing the Indian batsmen to get the better of them. So stay tuned for the big chase, which will be coming up shortly!

Kedar Jadhav was the one who provided the breakthrough and then Umesh Yadav rattled the Aussies with a 4-wicket haul. Rest of the bunch weren't too impressive and went for more than 6 runs per over. Travis Head and Peter Handscomb saw off the tricky period after the mini-collapse and the Aussies revived themselves with a strong finish. The latter played a major part in it as they scored 58 runs off the last 5 overs.

The pendulum swung from Australia to India and back in Australia's favour in the end. The visitors started off in dazzling fashion, tearing the Indian bowling apart and raising a 231-run stand. In that partnership, David Warner scored his 14th ton while his partner Aaron Finch fell just 6 runs short of his century. Both these batsmen fell on the same score and that opened the gates for India to come back.
Length delivery outside off, punched towards cover-point for a single. AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 334/5.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller in line of the stumps, Stoinis clips it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
SIX! That's just sheer power! Length delivery at a slower pace, Stoinis reads the pace well as he just whips it over the mid-wicket boundary for half a dozen.
Fires it fuller outside off, dug out towards extra cover for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, clipped through backward square leg for a couple. The fielder throws it back to the keeper's end and the ball hits Wade as Dhoni fails to collect it.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards long on for a single.
Angling into the batsman, Wade tries to defend it but gets hit on his body.
MATTHEW WADE strides out to bat!

OUT! What a comeback from Umesh Yadav! He comes steaming in from over the wicket and keeps it a touch ahead of a length, outside off. Handscomb swings his bat in hope of connecting another, but his bat is nowhere near the ball this time. Finds his off stick rattled and Handscomb has to walk back to the hut. A handy cameo comes to an end!
SIX! That's into the orbit! Yadav bowls a leg spinner outside off, Handscomb reads it well and smashes that over the long on region for half a dozen.
FOUR! Good length delivery outside off, Handsomb lofts it over covers. Rahane comes running in from the deep but fails to stop it. The ball runs through to the fence.
Short delivery outside off, punched through point for a single. The fielder  throws it back towards the keeper's end but awkward bounce denies Dhoni the run out chance.

Dhoni saves a certain boundary! Full and angling into the pads, Stoinis fails to clip it through. Brushes his pads and goes fine down the leg side. Dhoni dives to his left and gets a hand to it. The ball goes towards fine leg and the fielder in deep cuts it off and saves two runs for his team.
Full and sprayed into the pads, clipped towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller delivery around off, driven back to the bowler.
Slower delivery outside off, dabbed towards backward point for a single.
Length delivery around middle and leg, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Short and angling into the batsman, pulled towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller delivery around off, driven towards Sharma at covers who misfields and allows the batsmen to run two.
Full toss down the leg side, Handscomb shuffles across, gets an inside onto his pads for a single.
MARCUS STOINIS is the new man in!

OUT! Slower delivery does the trick! Short delivery around leg, Head camps back and tries to slog it over the square leg region. Gets elevation on it but fails to get the distance as the ball skies straight towards Rahane in the deep, who takes a well-judged catch near the fence. Yadav gets his third here. Head's struggle comes to an end.
Wide! Fires this way outside off, Head lets it through to the keeper.
Short delivery into the batsman, Head goes for the pull. Gets it through backward square leg. Rahane overruns it but still manages to stop it. A couple of runs taken.
Slow and short outside off, Handscomb shuffles across and punches it through point for a single.
Fires this fuller into the pads, Head clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Top shot, this! Short delivery into the pads, Head backs himself this time, camps back and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen.
Wide! Full and wide outside off, Head throws his bat at it but he fails to make contact.
Lights have been switched on at M.Chinnaswamy!
Head clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.

Shout for LBW! Length delivery around leg, Head tries to heave it on the leg side. Fails to make contact as he gets rapped on the pads. The ball ricochets through short third man for a couple of leg byes. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Replays show it was pitched outside leg. 50-run stand between Head and Handscomb.
Wide! Sprays down the leg side, Head tries to flick it but it is way too wide.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Handscomb stays tall and flicks it towards mid on for a single.
Length delivery around leg, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Low full toss as Handscomb clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Top shot, this! Fuller outside off, Handscomb leans forward and drives it beautifully through the mid off region for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Head goes for the pull. Gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a single.
Driven towards long on for a single.

Fuller and angling into the stumps, Handscomb stays in his crease and flicks it uppishly over mid-wicket. Virat Kohli runs across from long on, dives to his right and makes a brilliant stop. Saves two vital runs for his team.
Full and wide outside off, Head throws his bat at it. Gets an outside edge on it and the ball flies towards third man for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Head slashes his bat hard at it but he fails to make contact.
Good length delivery around off, Handscomb pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
UMESH YADAV is back into the attack.
Handscomb stays in his crease and drives it through covers for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards point off the back foot.
Around middle and off on a length, Peter shuffles across and clips it towards mid-wicket.

Full and drifting into the pads, Handscomb shuffles across and clips it through square leg. Chahal from mid-wicket, runs to his right, dives and saves a couple of runs for his team. The umpire goes upstairs to check it and replays show that it is a really good effort by the leggie.
Slower delivery on a fuller length in line of the stumps, Head eases it down towards long on for a single.
Full and angling into the batsman, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
MOHAMMED SHAMI is back on!
Around middle and leg, flicked towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, Handscomb punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full toss into the pads, Handscomb kneels down and plays the slog sweep over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Full and wide outside off, cut towards the fielder at point.
Fuller and angling into the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Short and spinning into the batsman, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery into the stumps, dig out back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Head uses his feet well to camp back and smack it through the cover region for a boundary.
Around middle and off, Head pushes it back towards the bowler.
Shorter around off, Handscomb camps back and punches it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up around middle and leg, driven towards long on for a single.
Bowls this one way outside off, Head shoulders his arms to it. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Change in bowling as YUZVENDRA CHAHAL walks out to bat.
Short and down the leg side, Head pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Head camps back and defends it neatly.
Tossed up outside off, Head drives towards covers but he cannot beat the diving Rohit Sharma.
Fuller around middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Sprayed into the pads, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller into the pads, clipped towards long on for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Handscomb goes for a punch. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length delivery around middle and leg, driven down the ground for a single towards long on.
Back of a length delivery around off, Handscomb stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Another back of a length delivery outside off, Head again goes for the pull. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length delivery outside off, Head fails to pull it this time.
MOHAMMED SHAMI is brought back.
Bowls this one with an even more slinging action. Pitches it outside off, Head punches it through covers for a single.
Wide! Fires this way down the leg side, Head lets it through.
Shorter around off, punched towards long on for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drifting into the pads, Head clips it towards short fine leg for a single.
Flatter and wide outside off, Head camps back and cuts it through the point region. Pandey cuts it off and saves two runs for his team.
Shorter around off, punched towards mid off.

In the air...safe! Shorter delivery around off, the ball stops a bit on the deck. Head ends up lobbing it straight back. The ball goes just over the bowler's head for a single. The fielder from mid on cuts it off and has a shy at the non-striker's end. Had he hit, it would have been close.
Short delivery outside off, Head stays in his crease and defends it.
Back of a length delivery around off, punched off the bottom half back to the bowler.
Angling into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Handscomb shuffles across and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple to get off the mark.
PETER HANDSCOMB strides out next.

OUT! Umesh strikes again and that's his 100th ODI wicket! Fuller delivery and angling into the pads, Smith shuffles across and ends up clipping it straight into the hands of Virat Kohli at mid-wicket. The Indian skipper catches a dolly and his counterpart has started walking back to the hut. Australia are once again losing the plot just like the last game.
Smith camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.
Wide! Hurls it down the leg side, Smith misses his paddle scoop.
Sprayed down the leg side, Smith clips it on the leg side.
Eased towards long off for a single.
Floated outside off, driven towards covers where Sharma dives to his right to make a brilliant stop.
Quicker outside off, stays low. Head gets his bat down in time to defend it.
Floated down the leg side, Smith clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
STEVEN SMITH walks out to the middle.

OUT! Another wicket goes down and suddenly Australia have lost both their openers. Full and wide outside off, Finch loses his patience there after playing four dots in a row. Tries to go over mid on but gets it off the bottom half. The ball goes straight towards Hardik Pandya at the edge of the circle, who accepts it gleefully. Umesh Yadav is excited and a stunning innings from Finch comes to an end. Missed out on his ton by just 6 runs. This brings two new batsmen out in the crease.
Fuller and drifting into the pads, fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads and rolls towards the keeper.
Length delivery outside off, Finch comes forward and manages to defend it on the off side.
Angling into the batsman, defended on the leg side.
Shorter delivery outside off, punched towards covers.
UMESH YADAV is back on.
Drinks have been taken. Meanwhile, TRAVIS HEAD to bat at number 3.

OUT! Warner departs! A dazzling and an entertaining innings comes to an end! Jadhav has done the trick here and the Indians have finally got a wicket. Short delivery around middle and leg, Warner camps back and goes for the pull. Does not get the elevation on it and gets it straight towards long on. Axar Patel holds onto it and David has to walk back to the hut. Kedar is all pumped up and this just might be the wicket the hosts were waiting for.
Short and wide outside off, punched towards long off for a single.
Quicker outside off, eased towards long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven towards extra covers.
Shorter around off, punched through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BAMM! Finch is not holding back either! Fuller into the pads, Aaron comes down a touch and smacks that over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen.
FOUR! Short outside off, Warner hangs back and slaps it through backward point for a boundary. 16 runs off the over!
Patel sprays it wide outside off. Warner walks across to play but misses. He looks to the umpire for a wide but doesn't get it, no idea why!
FOUR! Axar fires it outside off, Warner goes back, uses the pace and slaps as well through covers. Even a diving effort in the deep can't stop the boundary.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for a brace.
SIX! That's massive! A 107-metre maximum! Full outside off, Warner sees that it's in his arc and smashes it over long on for a maximum. Hits the roof there. This is some beating by the Australians!
Flatter outside off, cut to extra cover.
Short outside off, cut to deep extra cover for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot to extra cover.
Around leg, swept behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full around leg, paddle swept to short fine leg.
Shorter outside off, slapped through cover-point for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Knocked off the back foot to long off for a single.
Wide outside off, Finch makes room and smashes it on the off side. It falls just short of the man at extra cover, who can only half stop it. A single is taken.
Shorter outside off, cut to covers.
Warner dances down the track, Patel fires it on the pads. Flicked fine down the leg side for a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off, punched though covers for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. Two runs added to the total.
Punched off the back foot to extra cover.

FOUR! 14th ODI ton for Warner! Jadhav sprays it full and wide outside off, David reaches for it and gets it past backward point this time. The ball races away to the fence and Warner jumps and pumps his fist in the air. His typical century celebration! What a knock it has been! His second ton against India!
A touch shortish around off, Warner cuts it to backward point.

Fired full around leg, Finch smartly paddles it fine down the leg side. Pandya there makes a diving stop to his right. Keeps the batsmen down to a single. This now the highest partnership at this venue!
BEATEN! Jadhav bowls a side arm, Finch looks to dab it away but is beaten.
Warner goes back and cracks it through wide mid off for a single.
KEDAR JADHAV has been handed the ball. Can he provide the breakthrough India need?
Warner works it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single. He will keep the strike!

Overthrow! Darted on the pads, clipped behind sqaure on the leg side. They think of two but seeing Shami charge to the ball, decide against it. Mohammed has a shy at the bowler's end and his the stumps. The ball deflects away and Australia eventually get the second run.
Full on middle and off, drilled back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Smart cricket from Finch! Sliding down leg, Aaron kneels down and smartly sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary. He has started to pick up regular boundaries now.
AXAR PATEL is called back into the attack.
Finch goes back and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Warner makes room and slices it through covers for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, Warner plants his front foot ahead, goes for an expansive drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Punched off the back foot to extra cover.
A touch short outside off, spinning away, Finch goes back and cuts it through point for a single.
Tossed up around leg, worked round the corner. The fielder is there and no run is conceded.
Slower delivery outside off, played with an angled bat towards backward point for a single.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On a length and angling away from the southpaw, Warner slashes through cover-point. A fumble in the deep by Rahane allows the batsmen to pick up a brace.

Leg bye! Shout for lbw! Length delivery, angling down leg. Finch gets on his toes and looks to work it across the line but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls on the leg side. Pandya appeals but the umpire isn't interested. A leg bye is taken.
Hardik Pandya drops the ball during his run up. The ball rolls away to the pitch. Warner rushes to the ball, picks it up and throws it back to Hardik.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
SIX! Finch is livening the party even more! Tossed up full around off, Finch smokes it over long off for a biggie. 13 runs off the over. Australia are cruising through!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Guided down to fine leg by the batsman.
Slower though the air around leg, spinning away, worked to long on for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up around leg, Finch gets down on one knee, gets a top edge over backward square leg. There's no fielder there and the ball races away to the fence. He has decided to get a move on!
Warner kneels down and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Poor line, punished! Sliding down leg, Finch delicately works it fine down the leg side. The ball races down to the fence for a boundary.
Knocked down to long off for a run again.
Punched to long off for a single.

SIX! Finch cuts loose now! Fired around off, Finch goes through with his favourite inside-out shot. Connects it so well that the ball travels the distance for half a dozen. He is looking superb out there.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Shout for caught behind! Sliding down leg, Warner looks to work it off the back foot but misses. Dhoni collects the ball and appeals but it's turned down. The Snicko shows that it brushed David's thigh.

That was very close! Slower one around leg, Finch makes room, swings his bat but misses it completely. The ball whizzes past the leg pole. Dhoni this time collects the ball in a flash and whips off the bails but Finch's feet are grounded.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

17th ODI fifty for Aaron Finch! Tossed up around middle, Finch kneels down and sweeps it towards cow corner. The deep mid-wicket fielder has some ground to cover and a brace is picked with ease. Finch delivers once again. He was dearly missed in the first two ODIs.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Clever from Chahal, but even better from Warner! David gives the charge, Chahal spots that and sprays it way wide outside off. Warner is alert and reaches out for it, placing it towards point.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Around leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
Punched off the back foot wide of the cover fielder for a single.
Fired full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.

A muted appeal for lbw! But, it was sliding down leg. Arm ball around leg, Warner kneels down to sweep but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down. He was struck way outside the line.
Wide! Sliding down leg, Warner misses his flick and a wide is signalled.
Full on middle, knocked to extra cover.
A touch shorter around off, cut in front of square on the off side for a single.
Straying around leg, worked fine down the leg side for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Punched off the back foot to extra cover.

A stumping chance missed by MS Dhoni! Can you believe it? Chahal drifts it around leg. Finch dances down the track and swings his bat but it is nowhere close to the ball. Dhoni, who is very sharp behind the stumps normally fails to get his gloves near to the ball. The white object brushes his thigh and races down to the fence for four byes. Will this chance prove costly?
Leg spinner around off, Warner cuts through point for a single.
Finch goes back and punches it to covers.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Warner hangs back and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Loud shout for lbw! Another arm ball on middle. Warner shuffles a touch to work it across the line but misses. Gets rapped on the pads and the Indians start appealing. The umpire stays put though.
Full on middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
Sliding into the pads, turned on the leg side in front of square.
Played with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.

Another short delivery outside off, spinning in. Rises a touch on Warner, who goes back to cut but mistimes it through the gap between backward point and short third man. The backward point fielder chases it down and keeps the batsmen to a brace.
Shortish outside off, spinning away, cracked off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Pushed through mid off for a single.

SIX! Bang! Warner is having a gala time out there. He kneels down and slog sweeps the fuller delivery over mid-wicket. Rahane in the deep is just a mere spectator. Warner is looking really dangerous and India has to take his wicket quickly.
Lucky Finch! Patel drops it short, Finch hangs back and goes for a big pull. Is early into the shot and gets an inside edge past the stumps. He could have easily dragged that on.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Warner dances down the track and eases it down to long on for a run.
Full on middle and leg, pushed to mid-wicket.
Sliding into the pads, Warner defends it on the leg side.
Arm ball on middle, turned to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Spin on that occasion! Loopy delivery on middle, Warner shuffles a touch to work it with the spin. Misses and gets rapped on the thigh pad.
A touch shortish, Warner goes back and punches it through the off side for a brace.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
SIX! Boom! Tossed up around off, Warner kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a maximum. David loves this ground and has a phenomenal record here in the Indian T20 League.

Finch goes back and works it behind square leg and takes off for a run. Jadhav gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end, seeing Finch slow to take off. The throw however misses and a single is completed with ease.
Wide! Slider down the leg side, Finch looks to work it away but misses. Dhoni isn't able to collect the ball cleanly but still no extra run conceded.
Very full on middle and off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Pushed to covers off the front foot.

Axar saves a boundary! Full outside off, Finch goes after it. Slices it over the cover region. Patel at sweeper, hares to his left and stops the ball with an outstretched left hand. Saves a couple of runs for his team.
Almost a wide yorker, David crouches and places it through cover-point for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Warner mistimes his punch to extra cover.

FOUR! Yadav makes the contact with the ropes and the ball at the same time. Very full on middle and off, Warner drills it hard straight down the ground through the off side. Yadav at long off, sprints to his left, slides to make the stop but seems to have made contact with the ropes at the same time. The umpire signals a boundary after a confirmation from upstairs. Warner getting value for his shots today!

Time for Drinks! Australia have been cruising with the bat and both their openers are looking settled in the middle. They will look to make the most of their starts. India on the other hand will be hoping for a couple of quick wickets to get back into the game.
Quicker and angling into the pads, defended off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, driven towards long off for a single.
Warner stays deep in his crease and defends it on the off side.
Quicker into the pads, Finch fails to clip it through. Brushes his pads and goes towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
Flatter outside off, Warner camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.
Floated around leg, driven back to the bowler.
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is brought in for a bowl.
Short and wide outside off, slapped through backward point for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards covers.
100 up for Australia! Length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single. 5th 100-run stand between Warner and Finch! The Aussies will now look to build on this.
Slower delivery outside off, mistimes his punch through covers for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Warner flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Angling into the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! 17th ODI fifty for David Warner! Short and wide outside off, Warner cuts it through the point region for a boundary. The southpaw has been looking fantastic and he is already making a mark on his 100th ODI.

SIX! A bit short and Axar has been punished for it! Around middle and off, Warner camps back and smashes that over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen. First one of the day and Warner is looking his self today.
Again down the leg side, Warner goes to play the reverse sweep. Gets it towards backward point.
Flatter outside off, Warner stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller into the pads, clipped towards square leg.
Good length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot through the cover region for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, defended towards covers.
Short delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Wide! Sprayed way down the leg side, too wide for Warner to clip. Dhoni dives to his right to stop it, ends up diving on the ball.
Fuller delivery around off, driven back to the bowler.
Fuller and angling into the pads, Warner fails to clip it through. Gets hit low on his pads.
Quicker into the pads, Warner clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Short and wide outside off, Warner camps back and slaps that through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Flatter around off, defended off the back foot towards point.
Short and angling into the batsman, Finch camps back and punches it through the right of the bowler for a single.
Shorter around off, punched through extra cover for a single.
Floated outside off, Finch drives it through covers for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards extra covers. Umesh Yadav cuts it off with a dive and the batsmen run a single.
Angling into the hips, Finch clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Length delivery outside off, Finch camps back and punches it through covers. Chahal tries to cut it off but the ball wins the race to the fence.
Short and wide outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
Wide! Sprayed wide down the leg side, Warner lets it through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
HARDIK PANDYA is called in for a bowl.
Short and angling into the batsman, Finch camps back and punches it back to the bowler.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot by Warner towards long off for a single.
Tossed up around off, Warner comes down the track and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter around off, punched towards covers by the batsman.
Quicker around off, Warner stays in his crease and defends it.
Floated outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Now a maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle. Meanwhile, AXAR PATEL is introduced into the attack.
FOUR! Brilliant! Fuller delivery outside off, Finch leans forward and drives it through the cover region for a boundary. 13 runs off the over.
Angling into the hips, clipped on the leg side.
Length delivery outside off, Warner stays in his crease and pushes it towards mid off for a quick single. The fielder has a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Warner is well in.
Angling into the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top shot! Short delivery outside off, punched through extra cover for a boundary.

FOUR! Sloppy and that is the last thing India would want! Length delivery outside off, Warner stays in his crease and slaps it towards cover-point. Pandey and Pandya both were expecting the other to stop the ball. None stop it and the ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Finch stays in his crease and punches it towards mid off.
50 up for Australia! Angling into the hips, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery around off, pulled in front of square leg.
Length delivery outside off, punched towards covers by Warner.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed towards covers off the back foot.
Fuller delivery outside off, driven towards covers. Virat Kohli has a shy at the non-striker's end but he fails to hit it. Aaron Finch was anyway inside the crease.
Good length delivery around middle and off, Finch stays in his crease and defends it.
FOUR! Deft! Slower delivery again and Finch just makes the most of it. Good length delivery around off, Aaron stays in his crease, waits for the ball and glides it past the keeper for a boundary.
Angling into the hips this time, clipped towards mid-wicket by the batsman.
Good length delivery outside off at a slower pace, Finch reads it well and defends it on the off side.
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Good length delivery outside off, serving away. Finch tries to play at it but gets beaten by the away movement.
Low dipping full toss, right in line of the stumps. Warner digs it out neatly.
Short delivery around off, Warner ducks underneath it.
Fuller delivery angling into the pads, carved towards covers by David.
FOUR! Good shot! Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Warner camps back and half pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards covers by the batsman.
FOUR! Lucky runs ! Fuller delivery outside off, Finch just relishes the length and fancies the drive on it. Gets it off the inner half, through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Finch mistimes his pull towards fine leg for a single.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Finch fails to clip it through. Does not make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards covers.
Length delivery outside off, Finch stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
Good length delivery angling into the hips, Warner fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads and goes towards square leg for a leg bye.
Length delivery around off at 141 kph, Warner stays in his crease to defend it.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Fuller delivery outside off, Warner gets under the pitch of the ball and smashes it over the mid off region for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Finch stays in his crease and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards short covers.
Length around middle and off, Finch stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller delivery in line of the stumps, clipped towards mid on.
Length delivery around off, driven towards covers.
Short and wide outside off, Finch miscues his punch towards extra cover. 9 runs off the over.
Length around middle and leg, clipped off the back foot towards square leg.
Wide! Short and wide down the leg side, Finch fails to clip it through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
FOUR! Freebies! Sprays this again fuller into the pads, Finch adjusts well this time and flicks it elegantly through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fuller and angling into the pads, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top shot! Good length delivery around off, Finch camps back and punches it through the cover region for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Finch tries to smash it through covers. Gets an inside edge to it, which dies in the crease only.
FOUR! EDGED AND FOUR! Length delivery outside off, Warner tries to push at it on the off side. Gets a thick outside edge past the slip cordon for a boundary.
Fuller around off, Warner walks down a touch and drives it straight towards the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery around off, Warner gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Length delivery around middle and leg, Warner stays in his crease to defend. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Angling into the hips, Warner clips it through the square leg region. Chahal gives it a chase and keeps it to two.

FOUR! The first one for Warner! Fuller delivery outside off, David is not going to miss on those. Presses forward and drives it through the mid off region for a boundary. Such an elegant stroke, this!
Fuller delivery, angling into the pads. Finch defends it neatly on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Warner stays tall in his crease and punches it towards the extra cover region. Virat Kohli misfields and allows Warner to get off the mark with a single.
Umesh aborts his run-up halfway.
On a length around off, nipping away. Finch tries to defend it. Gets an outside edge to it and the ball flies towards the third man region for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, Finch clips it towards fine leg for a couple.
Around off on a good length, serving away. Aaron lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller delivery outside off, nipping away. Finch shoulders his arms to it. The ball bounces before Dhoni but he still manages to get his body behind it.
UMESH YADAV to bowl with the second new ball.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Warner stays in his crease and pushes it towards the cover region.
Good length delivery around middle and leg, Warner stays in his crease and defends it.
Length outside off, Finch slashes his bat at it. Gets an under edge on it and the ball goes on a bounce towards Dhoni who cannot stop it cleanly. The players run a single.
Brave leave! Good length delivery outside off, nipping in. Finch shoulders his arms to it.

FOUR! First runs for Australia! Shami strays this one fuller outside off, Finch cashes on the width and drives it through the cover-point region for a boundary. First one of the day and Finch is off the mark in style.
Starts the day by bowling on a fuller length around off, Finch mistimes his drive back to the bowler.

We are done and dusted with the national anthems of both the teams. Now, the players are making their way out in the middle. AARON FINCH and DAVID WARNER to open the innings for Australia. India have handed the responsibility of the first new ball to MOHAMMED SHAMI. Two slips in place for him. Here we go..

Virat Kohli says that the wicket is much more dry than it was in 2016. Adds that it will assist the slower bowlers. Mentions that they were looking to bat first as well. Informs that every guy is eager to perform and this series is not the end of the road for them. Ends by saying that every game is a motivation for them as each international game counts. Mentions that Jasprit Bumrah, Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Kuldeep Yadav have made way for Mohammed Shami, Umesh Yadav and Axar Patel.

Steven Smith says that he will bat first. Reckons that the wicket has changed a bit since they revamped the ground and he feels that it will slow up during the second half. Mentions that it has been a disappointing campaign till now and they will look to get back to winning ways. Ends by saying that Glenn Maxwell and Ashton Agar make way for Matthew Wade and Adam Zampa.
TOSS - Australia win the toss and elect to bat.

The visitors on the other hand have had a series to forget and they will be dying to get a win under their belt. Warner playing his 100th ODI today will look to create a spark in the contest as they have been lacking it a lot. The last time these two sides played here, Rohit Sharma went berserk as he smashed a swashbuckling 209 which India won by 57 runs. Currently it is not raining and hopefully we will get a full game of cricket. Stay tuned for the toss.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 4th ODI between India and Australia in Bengaluru. The hosts have already sealed the series and they will now be looking to make it ten wins in a row in ODIs. They might as well tinker with the starting XI but with the momentum they have, the Indians still are the favourites.
